fusions.name: Herd at Your Back
fusions.desc: Leads a shove into the cone ahead of you, which deals 10 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max +32%).

fusions.name: Lead Beast's Blow
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds after it lands.

fusions.name: Huddle for Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you also restore 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
